scope: three bounded Train-only diagnostics; no full retraining, no official Validation/Test, no perturbation, no publication
input_policy: Only previous Train-prepared.pt and saved students; original shared PKLs, official Validation artifacts and Test are not opened. No emotion labels.

overfit.selection: seeded selection exclusively from existing fit_indices, no target-based selection
overfit.loss: mean four original-scale 1024d BOS layer MSE, all backbone layers trainable
overfit.reason_for_no_regularization: Capacity diagnostic: remove dropout noise and parameter shrinkage; differs from original formal training and is not a causal dropout ablation.
overfit.interpretation: Report continuous reduction and residuals. Failure to reach zero in 500 steps alone cannot prove architectural incapacity. Tiny-set success cannot imply strict full-dataset compatibility.

framework.weights: same actual tensors from public HF checkpoint, mapped to native Fairseq only if all functional backbone tensors accounted for; verify exact values afterload

fit_dev_gap.loss: per-layer total squared error / (N*1024), overall average4

forbidden: hyperparameter sweeps or iterative adjustment for better result
